---
title: "Overview of the models"
---

METIS ships several model families. This page gives a very high-level comparison
so you can pick a starting point; each model has its own page with detail.

| Model | Stochastic | Training cost | Inference cost | Sequence conditioning | Exact density |
|-------|:-----------:|:-------------:|:--------------:|:---------------------:|:----------------:|
| [MLP](mlp.qmd) | ❌ | Low | Low | ❌ | ❌ |
| [Transformer](transformer.qmd) |❌ | High| Medium| ✅ |❌ |
| [Flow Matching](flow-matching.qmd) |✅  | High| High| ✅ |❌ |
| [Normalising Flow](normalising-flow.qmd) | ✅| Medium| Medium| ❌ | ✅|

Compute descriptions are qualitative, not a benchmark ranking: cost depends on
model size, horizon, hardware and sample count. Exact density means density of
the fitted continuous flow, not the exact simulator likelihood. The
[model-choice guide](../package/model-choice.qmd) gives a practical comparison
workflow; [conditioning](../package/conditioning.qmd) explains causal history
versus full-path information.
